args.title: Tamarack cold-chain series — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/cold-chain and its companion piece (https://insights.tamarack.example/cold-chain/companion):

- In 2026 cold-chain logistics, temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (25%).
